core_claim: 209 home bakers, given 80 years to remix the 1938 Toll House recipe, landed on a surprisingly tight consensus — eight canonical ingredients, a 0.40 butter-to-flour ratio, 350°F for 10 minutes — and when you take the median of that agreement, what emerges is an actual bake-able recipe that also happens to be what the highest-rated recipes look like.
tension: A recipe copied across 80 years should drift wildly. It hasn't. The internet's cookie is a small planet with a rigid core and a thin margin of weirdness.
payoff: A concrete 'most-average recipe' the reader can bake — and a new mental model of what a 'folk recipe' actually is.

edt_01.label: Hook — eight ingredients, 80 years, one cookie
edt_01.title: The Most Average Chocolate Chip Cookie
edt_01.editorial_notes: The 209 recipe count must stay. The Wakefield-1938 origin is the first hook — tell it as a single concrete story, not a list.

edt_02.title: A Cliff at 75%
edt_02.editorial_notes: The 25%-74% gap must be visible in the chart — this is the whole visual argument. An interactive chart where readers can hover/filter is ideal.

edt_03.title: The 0.40 Rule
edt_03.editorial_notes: Display 0.40 exactly; mention Wakefield's 0.44 as the reference line on the chart if possible.

edt_04.label: Sugar duet — brown + white
edt_04.title: Half White, Half Brown
edt_04.editorial_notes: Lead with the 80% figure. The median brown-share of 0.50 is a specific number worth visualizing as a reference line on the histogram.

edt_05.label: Leavening consensus
edt_05.title: Soda, Not Powder
edt_05.editorial_notes: Short, pithy section. Do not over-explain baking chemistry.

edt_06.label: Chocolate consensus
edt_06.title: Semisweet Wins
edt_06.editorial_notes: The 68.9% 'semisweet only' figure is the key number. Include the Wakefield-icepick anecdote at the end.

edt_07.title: Zucchini, Bourbon, White Pepper
edt_07.editorial_notes: This is the narrative turn — from orthodoxy to weirdness. Name specific oddball ingredients (zucchini, bourbon, coriander, white pepper) to make the point concrete.

edt_08.title: 80 Years Later
edt_08.editorial_notes: The 150% vanilla and +25% chocolate chip are the two specific claims. Do not round; keep them crisp.

edt_10.title: The Best Recipes Are the Orthodox Ones
edt_10.editorial_notes: The core payoff of the piece. The 10-of-10 and 9-of-10 ingredient tallies in the top-rated are the money claim.
